value.rationale: A natural sequence of classical Beer-type visibility probabilities yields a general if-and-only-if facet detection criterion and uniquely reconstructs an intrinsically geometric weighted facet spectrum, even for countably faceted bodies. Sharp simplex and parallelotope anchor extrema connect the invariant to concrete shape geometry; this is a structural classification, not a special-case recomputation. The theorem does not claim rates, generic body reconstruction or a paper-sized significance threshold.
